trigger: Build10 fixed-loopback report timed out before TCP; user separately reports computer on, USB connected, no VPN and no SideStore.

implementation.flow: Opt-in NWBrowser for one service; DNS-SD resolve/address APIs without candidate connection; exact local numeric ownership and TTL; TCP open and close without application frames.

safetyAndBoundaries: Accept exact captured local numeric addresses only; reject DNS host fallback, malformed/multicast/broadcast/mapped addresses, missing/conflicting scope and excluded interfaces.
Eligible interface names are numbered lo/en with up and non-point-to-point flags; this is narrow coverage, not proof that VPN or other transports are absent.

Snapshot comparison includes all captured IP nodes, including excluded interfaces, full raw flags, index, scope and IPv4 mask/broadcast; it does not cover addressless interfaces or all route/proxy changes.
SDK Host must round-trip address family, raw bytes and link-local interface index. Local destination ownership is not cryptographic device-service identity.
Only one explicit windowEnded followed by stream completion authorizes any connection. Overflow, invalidation, premature stream end and stale/removed generations fail closed.
Recheck address snapshot and DNS TTL before each serial attempt. TCP-ready is neither protocol authentication nor signing/installation/renewal.
C callback context and DNSServiceRef teardown stay on the serial dispatch queue required by the SDK; snapshots run in a detached utility task.
No credential, pairing file, device identifier, TXT, dynamic endpoint, interface name/index or raw server reply is exported. Counts, enums, elapsed times and numeric errors only.

verification.localSyntaxScreen: Seven modified Swift files checked with tree-sitter Swift grammar; no syntax errors. This is not Swift type checking or SDK compilation.
